Kronos K-line foundation model - bundled weights
================================================

Model family : Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
               (AAAI-40, arXiv:2508.02739)
Upstream     : https://github.com/shiyu-coder/Kronos
Weights      : https://huggingface.co/NeoQuasar/Kronos-mini
               https://huggingface.co/NeoQuasar/Kronos-Tokenizer-base
Licence      : MIT (both the code and the published checkpoints)
Copyright    : (c) the Kronos authors (NeoQuasar / Tsinghua University)

Files shipped in this directory are *converted* copies of the published fp32
checkpoints: every matrix (ndim >= 2) is stored as fp16, while 1-D tensors
(norms, biases, rope frequencies) stay fp32.  The conversion is reproducible:

    python tools/kronos/convert_weights.py <raw_checkpoints_dir> \
        src/main/resources/assets/financialmarket/models/kronos/

The Java inference stack (com.example.financialmarket.engine.ml) re-implements
the tokenizer and the decoder; no PyTorch or native runtime is required.

Redistribution of the MIT-licensed weights is permitted as long as this
copyright and permission notice are retained.
